about_the_game:
ZONARK

A lone soldier stands against a collapsing world.
Destroyed cities, abandoned facilities, and hostile environments have become deadly battlegrounds after a catastrophic zombie outbreak.

ZONARK is a first-person survival shooter (FPS) that blends intense action, tactical combat, and survival mechanics across multiple locations. Every area presents unique threats, limited resources, and constant pressure where survival is never guaranteed.

Multiple Locations and Environments

Fight your way through a variety of distinct stages and environments, each designed with its own atmosphere and gameplay challenges:

  • Ruined urban cities and abandoned streets

  • Damaged transport hubs and industrial zones

  • Open districts and confined interior spaces

  • Harsh winter environments with reduced visibility

Each location introduces new enemy encounters, traversal options, and combat pacing, keeping the experience varied and unpredictable.

FPS Combat Focused on Survival

ZONARK delivers fast, grounded, and unforgiving FPS combat.

  • Use a wide range of firearms, melee weapons, and explosives

  • Manage limited ammunition and supplies under constant threat

  • Positioning, movement, and timing are essential to survival

The game rewards tactical decision-making and awareness over reckless action.

Aggressive and Adaptive Zombie AI

Zombies are not mindless targets.
They pursue, surround, and pressure the player with aggressive and adaptive behavior, forcing constant movement and quick reactions during combat.

Every encounter carries risk, and mistakes are heavily punished.

Survival Systems

Survival extends beyond shooting.

  • Scavenge weapons, ammo, and medical supplies

  • Manage resources across hostile environments

  • Use rooftops, interiors, and underground routes to avoid or confront danger

The environment itself becomes a critical part of the survival experience.

Game Modes

Survival Mode (Waves)
Endure escalating waves of zombies across multiple environments, testing your skill, positioning, and resource management under constant pressure.

Open-Ended Survival Gameplay
Explore each location freely, engage enemies at your own pace, scavenge for resources, and approach combat situations using different strategies and routes.

Advanced Challenges
Higher difficulty settings, limited resources, and relentless enemy pressure for players seeking a hardcore survival experience.

A Dark and Unforgiving Zombie Survival Experience

ZONARK is a grounded FPS zombie survival game built around tension, atmosphere, and player skill. There are no safe zones, no easy solutions, and no guaranteed escape.

The world has fallen.
Every location tells a part of the nightmare.
How long will you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (v.1803 or higher)
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5.1+ Recommended
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2060 super or AMD RX 6600-XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5.1+ Recommended
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: Survive the ultimate nightmare in a zombie-infested city! Scavenge weapons, battle relentless undead, and uncover the dark secret behind the outbreak. No escape, no mercy—only the strongest will last! 🔥🧟‍♂️🔥🎮
